scope: Controlled G1 synthetic domain, normative and visible RGB labels separate

status_values.not_applicable: No applicable event or object; record why when material

flash_sparse_rule: Global process may be incorrect while order/direction are unknown. Do not replace either original answer.
normative_reference: GF0023-2020; candidate source order is a hypothesis, not gold. Reference-consulted checkbox records user assertion only.
formal_practice_exclusion: 4 normative and12 RGB exercises plus11 disclosed demos do not enter formal statistics
legacy_exclusion: All38 pre-protocol records retained verbatim; not credited to prospective blinded statistics or completed facets
agreement: Compare frozen saved predictions to independent human global decision and each observed facet; report confidence errors and abstentions separately
false_accept: A group fails if any human-confirmed incorrect process is accepted as correct by frozen observer
denominator: Retain all64 source groups and1408 attempts in reporting. Unreviewed/disputed groups are pending; never certify 0/64 human false acceptance until all group negative references have been audited/adjudicated.
coverage: Report all-output coverage separately. Original100% clear-case result uses construction-defined1152 cases; do not label it human clear-case coverage. Human observability requires explicit facet judgments.
ambiguity: Human unknown is not silently counted as correct or discarded; retain full denominators and uncertainty
arbitration: Second independent review of heldout references recommended; unresolved material disagreement blocks definitive gold. Original P0 does not explicitly require two full reviewers; generated-domain EVAL-02 does.
threshold_changes: No changes to frozen observer/thresholds or rerunning current holdout. A correction creates a new evaluator/version with preserved old results and newly independent validation data.
metadata: Per-stroke timestamps are optional human evidence, not automatically completed timing gold
blinding: Own previous same-protocol labels can be restored; other reviewers and model/construction answers hidden. IDs are operational separation, not authentication against deliberate local-file access.
